title: Which apartments are over-priced, and how sure are we? Location, photos, text and a trust layer on krisha.kz ads
subtitle: Final: the Endterm model as the base, three new information sources fused and kept only if they beat it by the fixed 0.354 M rule, calibrated intervals for the user

s2_title: Question, base and what changed since the Endterm
s2_question: Which apartments in Astana and Almaty are asked above or below what comparable apartments go for, by how much, and how sure can we be?
s2_left: Same data and split:: 4,815 ads (Oct 2026), 3,852 training ads, the 963 saved test ads used once
Base = Endterm model, reproduced exactly:: tuned HGB on log price, CV {{base.cv_mae_M|.3f}} ± {{base.cv_mae_sd_M|.3f}} M, test MAE {{endterm.test_mae_M|.2f}} M, MdAPE {{endterm.test_mdape|.2f}} %
One rule for every model:: kept only if CV MAE < base − 0.354 M (Endterm fold SD, fixed) = {{final/selection:rule_threshold_M|.3f}} M on duplicate-aware folds ({{base.threshold_M|.3f}} M random)
New test:: 1,507 November ads, a month later, search-page level only
s2_right: Leakage audit:: duplicate ads found by photo hashes, embeddings, fields and text; grouped CV
Location:: OSM distances and counts (parks, schools, shops, centre)
Photos:: CLIP zero-shot, linear probes, fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0, Grad-CAM, mismatch flag
Text:: TF-IDF vs transformer embeddings as residual correctors; red flags
Trust layer:: conformal 80/90 % intervals, SHAP, 5 comparable ads, interval-based over-pricing flag
s3_title: Leakage audit: duplicates exist, but too few to bend the Endterm CV
s3_bullets: 4 signals:: pHash/dHash of photos, image-embedding cosine, structured fields (area 1 %, price 5 %, 150 m), text TF-IDF; stock photos (> 5 ads) ignored

Found:: {{leakage/leakage_summary:n_pairs}} pairs → {{leakage/leakage_summary:all_links.groups}} groups, {{leakage/leakage_summary:all_links.ads_in_groups}} ads; {{leakage/leakage_summary:same_flat.groups}} certainly the same flat
Test split:: {{leakage/leakage_summary:all_links.test_ads_with_train_twin}} test ads ({{leakage/leakage_summary:all_links.test_ads_with_train_twin_pct|.2f}} %) have a training twin

Repaired folds:: Endterm folds with each duplicate group in one fold: base {{leakage/leakage_summary:recommended_folds.base_cv_mae_M|.3f}} ± {{leakage/leakage_summary:recommended_folds.base_cv_sd_M|.3f}} M vs {{base.cv_mae_M|.3f}} M random; over 20 seeds duplicates add only +0.015 M
Decision:: repaired folds = primary scheme for the model choice; margin kept at 0.354 M (fold SD moves 0.26–0.50 with the seed; the earlier 6.459 threshold was wrong)
s4_title: Location: a smooth distance to the centre helps; more OSM objects add little
s4_bullets: Features:: haversine distance to centre, nearest park / school / kindergarten / shop / clinic, counts within 500 m and 1 km (BallTree, OSM Overpass)
Distance to centre alone:: {{geo/cv[distance to centre]:cv_mae_M|.3f}} M, most of the OSM gain
Raw ad-page fields alone:: {{geo/cv[base + raw fields]:cv_mae_M|.3f}} M: sparse columns add noise
s5_title: Photos: CLIP reads the renovation; the price model gains little from it
s5_bullets: Task the photos can see:: flat condition (fresh / good / needs repair / shell), grouped CV by duplicate photos
Frozen CNN + LR:: MobileNetV3 F1 {{photos/classifier_comparison[frozen mnv3]:macro_f1_cv|.3f}}, EfficientNet-B0 {{photos/classifier_comparison[frozen effnet_b0 + LR]:macro_f1_cv|.3f}}

CLIP linear probe:: macro-F1 {{photos/classifier_comparison[(c) CLIP linear probe]:macro_f1_cv|.3f}}; fine-tuned EfficientNet-B0 {{photos/classifier_comparison[fine-tuned]:macro_f1_fold0|.3f}} (fold 0)
Grad-CAM:: where the network looks; mismatch flag when photos contradict the stated condition
In the price model:: best {{photos/price_cv@best:cv_mae_M|.3f}} M ({{photos/price_cv@best:delta_vs_base_M|+.3f}}); {{photos/price_cv@n_pass}} of {{photos/price_cv@n}} pass
s6_title: Text: a residual correction that helps on every fold, but below the bar
s6_bullets: Sanitised first:: money sentences, digits and contacts removed, so the text cannot leak the price
As a residual corrector:: Ridge on the base model's inner-OOF log error, alpha by GCV per fold

TF-IDF vs transformer:: {{text/cv[TF-IDF word+char + Ridge residual]:cv_mae_M|.3f}} vs {{text/cv[user-base embedding]:cv_mae_M|.3f}} M, equal; embeddings as tree features {{text/cv[PCA(32)]:cv_mae_M|.3f}} M, worse
1-SD rule:: {{text/cv@n_pass}} of {{text/cv@n}} pass; red flags shown to the user, too rare to move the MAE
s7_title: Fusion and selection: per-step vs whole model
s7_bullets: Per-step forward selection (strict):: no block passes; the largest first step (photo features, −0.24 M) < 0.354 M → would keep the base

Whole model:: network + base 50/50 log-blend {{final/selection:whole_model_comparison.cv_mae_M|.3f}} ± {{final/selection:whole_model_comparison.cv_mae_sd_M|.3f}} M, −{{final/selection:whole_model_comparison.gain_vs_base_M|.3f}} M > 0.354, 5/5 folds
Not just ensembling:: blend with a tabular-only network is worse than the base
Random folds agree:: {{final/selection:choice_other_folds.random.cv_mae_M|.3f}} M vs 6.616: not from duplicates
Final = the blend:: certified as a whole, no single block certified
s8_title: Conformal intervals replace the fixed 20 % over-pricing rule
s8_bullets: Conformal:: out-of-fold scores, quantile ⌈(n+1)(1−α)⌉/n → guaranteed average coverage
Compared:: constant width on log residual vs conformalized quantile regression (CQR), per-city calibration

Chosen:: {{trust/chosen_settings:intervals.chosen_variant}}: 90 % coverage {{trust/chosen_settings:intervals.oof.0.9.coverage|.1%}}, median width {{trust/chosen_settings:intervals.oof.0.9.median_rel_width_pct|.0f}} % of the price
Flag:: over-priced if the price is above the upper 90 % bound; overlap with the 20 % rule {{trust/chosen_settings:flags.jaccard_over|.2f}} (Jaccard)
Why:: 20 % is too strict for standard flats, too lenient for unique ones
s9_title: Reasons and comparables: SHAP for the model, real ads for the user
s9_bullets: TreeSHAP:: exact Shapley values, one-hot columns summed to the source feature

Top features:: {{trust/chosen_settings:shap.top_features.0.feature}}, {{trust/chosen_settings:shap.top_features.1.feature}}, {{trust/chosen_settings:shap.top_features.2.feature}}; stable vs ordinal encoding (ρ {{trust/chosen_settings:shap.importance_spearman_onehot_vs_ordinal|.2f}})
Comparables:: 5 nearest training ads in the same city (area, rooms, year, floor, position)
Warning:: 5th neighbour far → few comparables: {{trust/chosen_settings:comparables.oof_warning_share|.1%}} of ads, larger errors there
Limit:: SHAP explains the model, not the market

s11_title: Where the final model is still wrong
s11_bullets: Absolute error grows with price:: MAE 2.1 M below 25 M, 28.9 M above 100 M
Shrinkage to the mean:: top band under-predicted (−9 %), cheapest over-predicted (+6 %)
Gain is in the bulk:: better in every city, band and room count except 4+ rooms (+0.84 M, CI crosses 0)
Worst 20 errors:: 17 are flats above 100 M, where the intervals are widest
s12_left: Endterm reproduced, CV honest:: duplicates few (+0.015 M), repaired folds are the primary yardstick
New sources carry signal:: best single blocks −0.15 to −0.24 M, none passes 0.354 M alone
Together they pass:: network + base blend, CV {{final/selection:whole_model_comparison.cv_mae_M|.3f}} M (base {{final/selection:base_cv_mae_M|.3f}})
s12_right: Test, once:: MAE {{final.test_mae_M|.2f}} M, MdAPE {{final.test_mdape|.2f}} % (Endterm {{endterm.test_mae_M|.2f}} M, {{endterm.test_mdape|.2f}} %)
Main gain for the user:: calibrated interval + reasons + 5 real comparables + adaptive flag, in an app
Next:: follow ads over time (price cuts, removal) → time-to-sale data, then decision models
s13_title: The app: one listing end to end
s13_bullets: Form → final model:: geo from coordinates, text flags + USER-base embedding from the description, CLIP embedding of up to 3 photos
Missing by design:: raw ad-page fields and photo-track table features (as for training ads without them); the app says so
Around the estimate:: conformal 80/90 % interval, verdict, SHAP reasons, 5 comparables, red flags, photo condition + mismatch
s14_title: Why no deep RL, and limitations
s14_left: No deep RL:: RL needs actions and rewards (sold? when? at what price?); we have asking prices only, no outcome, no days-on-market, one snapshot → it would collapse into our regression with more variance
Right tool:: supervised regression + calibrated uncertainty; RL only with longitudinal data
s14_right: Asking ≠ sale price:: 'over-priced' = above comparable asking prices
Reused test set:: 963 ads scored at the Endterm and once more here
November = listing level only:: ad pages blocked by bot protection; 17 of 24 fields
Whole-model certification only:: no single block passes step by step; removing location costs the blend most (+0.29 M)
Also:: one snapshot, seller-stated labels, OSM gaps, 5 folds a coarse ruler
